page_title: ACM 0-3 UDI | AC Milan v Udinese 11/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Matteo Marchetti has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
87' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
86' Substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp is replaced by Lennon Miller (Udinese).
85' Here is a change. Arthur Atta is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
83' The current number of shots on goal is 3:6.
80' Udinese take a short corner kick.
77' Substitution. Rafael Leao leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan).
76' Keinan Davis (Udinese) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Idrissa Gueye comes onto the pitch to replace him.
72' The referee signals a substitution. Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) is brought on as a substitute for Luka Modric.
72' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to make a change. Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) replaces Christian Pulisic.
71' 0 - 3 Arthur Atta (Udinese) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.

71' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
70' Luka Modric (AC Milan) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
70' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball is out of play. AC Milan win a corner kick.

67' A pass travels right across the box to Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye denies him with a decent save.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolo Zaniolo leaves the pitch and Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) comes on.
65' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

63' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Hassane Kamara (Udinese), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuele Ricci trots off the pitch and is replaced by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan).

60' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan.

56' Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) times his leap well to meet the lofted pass from Rafael Leao, but his close-range header slips just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

55' Oumar Solet (Udinese) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
51' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) sends a rebound goalwards towards the left-hand post, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it.
51' Luka Modric (AC Milan) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
50' Luka Modric (AC Milan) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Maduka Okoye. AC Milan get a corner.
47' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
46' Matteo Marchetti shows a yellow card to Thomas Kristensen (Udinese), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
46' Half-time substitution. Zachary Athekame will not participate anymore and Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) is coming on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+1' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Great ball in from Alexis Saelemaekers. Rafael Leao (AC Milan) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
44' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.

43' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Matteo Marchetti stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick has been awarded to Udinese.
42' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
40' Great teamplay by AC Milan as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

37' 0 - 2 Nicolo Zaniolo produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box where Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) rises high to head the ball off the woodwork into the bottom left corner. The score is now - 0:2.
37' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
36' OFF THE BAR! Keinan Davis (Udinese) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and fires a bullet of a shot that crashes against the crossbar.

36' Keinan Davis (Udinese) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Mike Maignan makes a great save to stop his effort.
34' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

32' Christian Pulisic beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Rafael Leao (AC Milan), who smashes a first-time shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

29' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan). Matteo Marchetti saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Udinese, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
27' 0 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 0:1.
25' Luka Modric (AC Milan) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
23' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. AC Milan earn a free kick.
22' Luka Modric (AC Milan) tries to find Zachary Athekame, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
21' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Rafael Leao (AC Milan) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
19' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) tries to find Keinan Davis, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
16' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) was probably a bit loose with his words to Matteo Marchetti, who decides to show him a yellow.
15' Luka Modric (AC Milan) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
14' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) is penalised for holding. Matteo Marchetti signals a set piece. AC Milan win a free kick.
13' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.

12' Christian Pulisic sprays a wonderful pass out to Rafael Leao (AC Milan), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Maduka Okoye problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
10' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball.
9' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
8' Oumar Solet (Udinese) attempts to release Keinan Davis with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.

6' Oumar Solet (Udinese) picks out Keinan Davis with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range. The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a throw-in.

3' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mike Maignan pulls off an easy save.
2' It could have been a good chance to score! Luka Modric (AC Milan) fails to release Zachary Athekame with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
1' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. AC Milan have a free kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Matteo Marchetti.
